source: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册B 第二课《故宫》
file_note: The workbook's exercises for 第二课, typed from 练习册B pp. 1–15 (PDF index = printed + 4, verified on p. 1, whose header reads 2 故宫 The Forbidden City). Same shapes as L03–L05: tf/order/slots/match/sort are marked by rule; write is judged stroke by stroke; free is grid writing for the chinese-review skill; read is recorded; speak is the parent-signed retell; the three word-box exercises are `blocks` naming zh-word items. Left out, with their keys so a type can be added: 星期五 练习1 (pp. 11–12, listen and choose, two options each — the script is in the appendix on p. 82: (1) 墙上挂着一张世界地图 → A 世界地图 (2) 哥哥在国外留学 → B 国外 (3) 故宫是中国明朝和清朝的皇宫 → A 明朝和清朝 (4) 故宫又叫紫禁城 → A 紫禁城), as L04 left out its two-option listening; a two-choice `pick` type would take it. Also left out: 内 from the 星期一 练习1 structure sorting (see that exercise's scope_note — its key would be 独体字 if the book means what its empty line suggests); the two pinyin-writing gourds of 星期三 练习1 (p. 6: 清 → qīng, 筑 → zhù). 星期二 练习4 (p. 6, 选择正确的句子并读一读) is a tf exercise followed by a read of the five right sentences, since the book asks for both. 星期四 练习3 (pp. 9–10) is split four ways; see the shape_note on zx:L02-D4-03. Note the workbook's p. 7–8 sentence 以后有机会我还想来故宫逛逛 has 想 where the 课文's 句子 has 要; each is typed as its own page prints it.

blocks.title: 选词填空
blocks.title_en: Choose the right words to fill in the blanks

blocks.title: 选词填空
blocks.title_en: Choose the right words to fill in the blanks
blocks.scope_note: The book offers six words (A 机会 B 游客 C 吸引 D 珍贵 E 展览 F 参观) for the six blanks of one passage. Each item carries four of them; the two left off each time are the ones that could also be argued into that blank on grammar alone (for instance 展览 after 以后有, or 机会 after 还有很多), so every wrong choice is plainly wrong and the task she faces is still the book's: which of the box fills this blank. The passage's other blanks are shown filled where the sentence needs them, as L03 did.

blocks.title: 选择恰当的词语完成对话
blocks.title_en: Choose the correct words to complete the dialogue
blocks.scope_note: The book offers five words (A 哪儿 B 看看 C 著名 D 珍贵 E 世界) for five blanks in one dialogue. Each item carries four; the one left off is the word that could also be argued into that blank (著名 before 的历史文物, 珍贵 after 最, 哪儿 as 'somewhere' at the end), or, where none could, the weakest. A word-box exercise, so bank items, as the contract maps them; the dialogue lines are the workbook's own.

exercises.title: 左右结构、半包围结构，还是独体字？
exercises.title_en: Left–right, half-enclosed, or a single-body character?
exercises.scope_note: The book lists five characters (朝 清 间 内 外) under three lines: 左右结构, 半包围结构, 独体字. 内 is left out of the sorting: 朝 清 外 are plainly left–right and 间 half-enclosed, so the book's empty 独体字 line suggests it means 内 as 独体字, but dictionaries and school lists commonly file 内 as 半包围结构 (上三包围, like 同 and 问). The page does not settle which the book intends, and a wrong key is worse than a missing item — the same call L03 made over 寿. 内 is still written in zx:L02-D1-01w. The 独体字 group is kept because the book prints it.

exercises.title: 选择正确的句子并读一读
exercises.title_en: Choose the correct sentences and read

note.zh: 每组两句，一句对、一句错。课本给的例子：有机会我要去故宫逛逛。（对）
note.en: Each pair has one right sentence and one wrong. The book's example: 有机会我要去故宫逛逛 is the right one.

exercises.scope_note: The book ticks the example's first sentence and leaves the rest blank. In every pair the right sentence is the one that doubles its verb (逛逛, 看看, 用用, 看看, 走走), the lesson's own pattern (以后有机会我还要来故宫逛逛); the example settles the key for the four pairs. The example pair is kept as two items, as L03 and L04 kept a book's drawn line.

items.text: 有机会我要去故宫逛逛。

explanation.zh: "逛逛"把"逛"说两遍，意思是随便走走、看一看——课本给的例子。
explanation.en: 逛逛 says the verb twice, which makes it a relaxed 'have a stroll round' — the book's own example.

explanation.zh: 句子停在一个"逛"上，听起来没说完；要说"逛逛"。
explanation.en: Stopping on a single 逛 sounds unfinished; the sentence wants 逛逛.

items.text: 奶奶对爸爸说：“常回家看看。”

explanation.zh: "看看"：回家来看一看，说得亲切自然。
explanation.en: 看看 — come home and look in on us — is the warm, natural way to say it.

items.text: 奶奶对爸爸说：“常回家看。”

explanation.zh: 一个"看"放在句尾，话像没说完；要说"看看"。
explanation.en: A single 看 at the end leaves the sentence hanging; it wants 看看.

items.text: 哥哥，我借你的铅笔用，好吗？

explanation.zh: 借来用一下，要说"用用"；只说一个"用"，听起来不自然。
explanation.en: Borrowing something for a moment is 用用, use it for a bit; a single 用 sounds abrupt.

items.text: 哥哥，我借你的铅笔用用，好吗？

explanation.zh: "用用"是用一下，说得轻、有礼貌。
explanation.en: 用用 means use it for a little while — light and polite.

items.text: 放假我也要去长城看看。

explanation.zh: "看看"是去看一看，和"去故宫逛逛"一样。
explanation.en: 看看 is go and have a look, just like 去故宫逛逛.

explanation.zh: 句尾只有一个"看"，话没说完；要说"看看"。
explanation.en: Ending on a single 看 leaves it unfinished; the sentence wants 看看.

items.text: 早上我会和姐姐在花园走。

explanation.zh: 在花园里随便走一走，要说"走走"；一个"走"放在句尾不自然。
explanation.en: A stroll round the garden is 走走; a single 走 at the end does not sound right.

items.text: 早上我会和姐姐在花园走走。

explanation.zh: "走走"是散散步、随便走一走。
explanation.en: 走走 means take a little walk, a stroll.

exercises.scope_note: The book's five gourds are nèi/内 (the example), jiān/—, —/清, —/筑 and cáng/—. The context names the lesson because the gourd gives the pinyin alone and the book relies on the lesson's 生字 list to make it one character.

note.zh: 按故事的先后排好四句话。
note.en: Put the four sentences in the order the visit happened.

exercises.page_note: The exercise starts at the foot of p. 7 and its last two sentences are at the top of p. 8; the pieces are in the book's printed order. The workbook's own wording (还想来, 只参观了著名的太和殿) differs from the 课文's and is typed as the workbook prints it.

pieces: 故宫真的很大，我们只参观了著名的太和殿。
今天妈妈带我去游故宫。
以后有机会我还想来故宫逛逛。
我们以天安门为起点，一路向北，从午门进入故宫。

explanation.zh: 故事的顺序：先说今天妈妈带我去游故宫，再说从天安门一路向北、从午门进去，然后说故宫很大、只参观了太和殿，最后说以后还想再来。
explanation.en: The order of the visit: Mother takes me to the palace today; we start at Tiananmen and go in by the Meridian Gate; the palace is huge and we see only the Hall of Supreme Harmony; and last, I want to come back.

exercises.title: 根据课文回答问题（1）
exercises.title_en: Answer the questions according to the text (1)
exercises.shape_note: 练习3 on pp. 9–10 is four questions of three kinds, so it is four site exercises: (1) has one answer among four, a slots item with the book's own four options; (2) and (3) ask 哪些 and have two and three right options, so each option is a true/false item (D4-03b, D4-03c); (4) is an open answer (D4-03d). Not bank items: one weekday holds one block, and 星期四's is 练习2.

explanation.zh: 课文第一句：今天妈妈带我去游故宫。
explanation.en: The text's first line: 今天妈妈带我去游故宫 — Mother takes me.

exercises.title: 根据课文回答问题（2）
exercises.title_en: Answer the questions according to the text (2)

note.zh: （2）故宫是中国哪些朝代的皇宫？答案不止一个：是的点"对"，不是的点"错"。
note.en: (2) Which Chinese dynasties was the Forbidden City the imperial palace of? There is more than one answer: tap True for each that is, False for each that is not.

explanation.zh: 课文说故宫是明朝和清朝的皇宫，没有说秦朝。
explanation.en: The text says it was the palace of the Ming and the Qing — not the Qin.

explanation.zh: 课文：故宫是中国明朝和清朝的皇宫。
explanation.en: The text: 故宫是中国明朝和清朝的皇宫 — the Ming is one.

explanation.zh: 课文说的是明朝和清朝，没有唐朝。
explanation.en: The text names the Ming and the Qing; the Tang is not one of them.

explanation.zh: 课文：故宫是中国明朝和清朝的皇宫。
explanation.en: The text: 故宫是中国明朝和清朝的皇宫 — the Qing is the other.

exercises.title: 根据课文回答问题（3）
exercises.title_en: Answer the questions according to the text (3)

note.zh: （3）故宫最著名的三座大殿是哪些？是的点"对"，不是的点"错"。
note.en: (3) Which are the three most famous halls of the Forbidden City? Tap True for each that is one, False for each that is not.

explanation.zh: 课文：今天我们只参观了它最著名的三座大殿：太和殿、中和殿和保和殿。
explanation.en: The text names 太和殿, 中和殿 and 保和殿 — 太和殿 is one.

explanation.zh: 课文：今天我们只参观了它最著名的三座大殿：太和殿、中和殿和保和殿。
explanation.en: The text names 太和殿, 中和殿 and 保和殿 — 中和殿 is one.

explanation.zh: 课文说的三座大殿是太和殿、中和殿和保和殿，没有交泰殿。
explanation.en: The three halls the text names are 太和殿, 中和殿 and 保和殿; 交泰殿 is not among them.

explanation.zh: 课文：今天我们只参观了它最著名的三座大殿：太和殿、中和殿和保和殿。
explanation.en: The text names 太和殿, 中和殿 and 保和殿 — 保和殿 is one.

exercises.title: 根据课文回答问题（4）
exercises.title_en: Answer the questions according to the text (4)

items.prompt_en: (4) Given the chance later on, what does the writer still want to do?

exercises.title: 根据提示完成对话
exercises.title_en: Follow the prompts to complete the dialogue

note.zh: 亮亮游北京路线——路线一：天安门广场、故宫、景山公园；路线二：南锣鼓巷、鼓楼、什刹海；路线三：长城、圆明园、颐和园。云云问：亮亮，你寒假去哪里玩儿了？……北京好多景点呢，你都去哪儿了？
note.en: Liangliang's routes round Beijing — Route 1: 天安门广场, 故宫, 景山公园; Route 2: 南锣鼓巷, 鼓楼, 什刹海; Route 3: 长城, 圆明园, 颐和园. Yunyun asks where he went in the winter holiday, and then which of Beijing's sights he saw.

items.prompt: 亮亮：我去了好多地方，有＿＿呀、＿＿呀、＿＿呀……我照了照片，你看！
items.prompt_en: 亮亮：我去了好多地方，有＿＿呀、＿＿呀、＿＿呀…… (three places on one route)

exercises.title: 根据提示写一写你出去玩儿的一天（四十字以上）
exercises.title_en: Follow the prompts to write about a day out with more than 40 characters

note.zh: 提示表：去（　　）玩。日期、天气、人物、地点、看了什么、玩儿了什么、吃了什么、心情怎么样。
note.en: The prompt table: 去（　）玩 — where you went; then the date, the weather, who was there, the place, what you saw, played and ate, and how you felt.

items.prompt: 写一写你出去玩儿的一天（四十字以上）。
items.prompt_en: Write about a day out (more than 40 characters).

exercises.title: 看图，判断正误
exercises.title_en: Look and check

note.zh: 图在练习册第12页。每组两句，一句对、一句错。课本给的例子：爸爸在开车。（对）
note.en: The pictures are on workbook p. 12. Each pair has one right sentence and one wrong. The book's example: 爸爸在开车 is the right one.

explanation.zh: 图上是爸爸在开车——课本给的例子。
explanation.en: The picture shows the father driving — the book's own example.

explanation.zh: 开车的是爸爸，不是妈妈——课本给的例子。
explanation.en: The driver is the father, not the mother — the book's own example.

explanation.zh: 图上的女士站在讲桌后面，一手拿书，一手拿教鞭：是老师。
explanation.en: The woman stands behind a desk with a book in one hand and a pointer in the other: a teacher.

explanation.zh: 她拿着书和教鞭站在讲桌后面，是在上课，不是在看病。
explanation.en: With a book and a pointer behind a desk she is teaching, not treating patients.

explanation.zh: 图上是几朵红花，花是用眼睛看的：看看美丽的花。
explanation.en: The picture shows red flowers, and flowers are for looking at: 看看美丽的花.

explanation.zh: 图上没有歌，只有花；歌是听的，花是看的。
explanation.en: There is no song in the picture, only flowers; songs are heard, flowers are seen.

exercises.title: 连一连
exercises.title_en: Match

note.zh: 左边是问的话，右边是回答。先点左边一句，再点右边回答它的那一句。
note.en: On the left, the questions; on the right, the answers. Tap a question, then the answer that goes with it.

right: 我去北京看望爷爷奶奶了。
好玩儿！有机会你也去逛逛吧。

explanation.zh: 问去哪儿，答一个地方：我去北京看望爷爷奶奶了。
explanation.en: Asked where, the answer names a place: 我去北京看望爷爷奶奶了.

explanation.zh: 看到长城，就说：真好看！我也要去看看。
explanation.en: Shown the Great Wall, you say how lovely it is and that you want to go and see it too.

explanation.zh: 问"和谁"，答一个人：和妈妈。
explanation.en: Asked 'with whom', the answer is a person: 和妈妈.

explanation.zh: 问好不好玩儿，答：好玩儿！有机会你也去逛逛吧。
explanation.en: Asked whether it is fun, the answer begins 好玩儿 — yes, it is.

exercises.title: 父母读给孩子听，听后一起说一说感想
exercises.title_en: Ask your parents to read, listen and tell what you think

question.zh: 听了《爱旅行的小火车》，你有什么感想？
question.en: After hearing 爱旅行的小火车, what do you think?

note.zh: 请爸爸妈妈读练习册第13–15页的《爱旅行的小火车》给你听。听完说说你的感想，录下来，再请他们点一下"家长已听"。
note.en: Have a parent read 爱旅行的小火车 on workbook pp. 13–15 to you. Then say what you think and it is recorded; have them tap Listened.

exercises.title: 根据提示写一写你的旅游日记（四十字以上）
exercises.title_en: Follow the prompts to write a travel diary with more than 40 characters

note.zh: 提示：谁带你去的？你们什么时候去的？去了哪里？有什么好玩儿的东西吗？有什么美食吗？你们吃了什么？你喜欢那里的景色和美食吗？……
note.en: Prompts: Who took you? When did you go? Where did you go? Was there anything fun? Was there good food, and what did you eat? Did you like the scenery and the food there? …

items.prompt: 写一写你的旅游日记（四十字以上）。
items.prompt_en: Write your travel diary (more than 40 characters).
